definitions.short: Gomer , the name of a son of Japheth and of his descendants; also of a Hebrewess
definitions.full: H1586. Gomer גֹּ֫מָר proper name 1.masculine a. son of Japhet Gen 10:2-3 ,= 1Chr 1:5-6 , Ezek 38:6 ; Lag Onom. Sacr. 2, 95, 2nd ed. 367, see BN 77 proposes גמרים for גמדים 27:11 q. v.; he identification גֹּמֶר with Cappadocia (compare ᵑ7 27:11 , Kiep Lb. d. alt. Geogr. 91 ) = Armenian Gamir - χ (with plural ending) see also Lag Arm. Stud. 32 § 448 ; compare further Assyrian Gimirrai , Schr KG 157 ff. Dl Pa 245 f. also Len Or.ii. 1, 332 ff. 2. feminine wife of Hosea , Hosea 1:3 .

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.
Gomer, and all his hordes; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his hordes; even many peoples with you.
So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; and she conceived, and bore him a son.
